assumptions: Cells are exchangeable within an image: the null keeps every position and permutes the labels.
limits: The neighbour graph is exact brute force; BiocNeighbors' tie order in kNN is not reproduced. p-values are not corrected across pairs.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which cell types sit next to each other more, or less, often than a random arrangement of the same cells?

description: imcRtools' testInteractions on a project single-cell table (imaging mass cytometry, CODEX, MIBI): per image, a k-nearest or radius neighbour graph on the cell centroids, then for every ordered pair of cell types a neighbourhood statistic (classic, histoCAT conditional, patch or interaction share) against permutations of the cell-type labels within the image; p (smaller side), z-score and the interaction or avoidance call.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

graph.description: k nearest cells, or every cell within a radius.

image.description: the image column; empty to guess it.

label.description: the cell-type column; empty to guess it.

patch_size.description: patch: to-type neighbours a cell needs.

radius.description: the expansion radius, in position units.

table.description: the project cell table (CSV or TSV, one row per cell).

x.description: the centroid X column; empty to guess it.

y.description: the centroid Y column; empty to guess it.

name: test_cytometry_spatial_interactions

pairs.description: per image and ordered type pair: statistic, p, z and the call
